overview: The Commission for Persons with Disabilities reviewed logistical plans, vendor recruitment, and activities for the upcoming Disability Fair. The commission also received an update on the City Council advancing its proposed ordinance to the mayor for legal review.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Notes
items.summary: The commission approved the meeting notes from the previous month.

items.title: Disability Fair Vendor and Logistics Update
items.summary: Nicholas Karinge shared the roster of confirmed and prospective vendors for the Disability Fair, and commissioners discussed day-of volunteer duties and attendee sign-in tracking.

items.title: Disability Fair Site Tour Announcement
items.summary: Karinge announced a walkthrough of the event venue and playground scheduled for Friday, April 10, at 11:00 a.m.

items.title: Assistive Device Decorating Table
items.summary: The commission discussed plans to partner with the Medford Public Library makerspace to host an all-ages assistive device decorating table at the fair.

items.title: Update on Commission Ordinance
items.summary: Anthony Andreottola and Karinge reported that the City Council voted 7–0 to send the commission's proposed updated ordinance to the mayor for legal review.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Disabled veteran and Medford resident Mark Ingram introduced himself, and the commission welcomed him to the meeting.
